data.answer: Authenticated vulnerability scans of production run weekly. Patch deadlines from the date a vulnerability is confirmed are: critical within 72 hours, high within 14 days, and medium within 60 days.

Nimbus Labs does not sell customer data, and customer data is not used to train machine learning models. Access by Nimbus Labs staff is limited to support and operations needs under the access control policy.

Secrets are stored in AWS Secrets Manager and are never committed to source control. A secrets scanner blocks any commit that contains a secret, and engineers complete secure coding training once a year.

After a contract ends, customer data stays available for export for 90 days. Once that window closes, the data is deleted from production systems within 30 days, and backups containing that data expire on their normal 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.
Application and system logs are retained for 400 days.
Database backups are retained for 35 days.
Security audit logs are retained for 7 years.
Access reviews run every quarter. Managers confirm or remove each person's access, and the Engineering Manager signs off the review.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords, and shared accounts are not permitted.

Production access is just-in-time and granted on a least-privilege basis tied to a person's role, where every grant has a named approver, is recorded in the audit log, and lasts a maximum of 8 hours before expiring automatically. Interns are not eligible, high-risk applications including AWS production need approval from the Engineering Manager, and in an incident the on-call engineer may take emergency access for up to 2 hours without prior approval with retrospective approval required within 24 hours.
